correctness.rationale: The normalized analytic monomial moment is B(n+b,m+1)/B(b,m+1), so K is a positive constant times the generating polynomial numerator over (1-s)^(m+2). Exact symbolic replay proves every displayed resultant, and all positive-parameter factors are nonzero except b=2 for boundary order four. The numerator at b=1 is a nonzero constant; at b=2 its explicit factorization locates exactly two unit-circle roots and three exterior roots. Implicit differentiation yields radial derivative -49/360, hence the pair enters. Absence of all later boundary resultants fixes the count at two; the nonzero discriminant proves simplicity for b>2. Both normalizations and all parameter boundaries are addressed. Symbolic checks are algebraic proof certificates, while sample numerical roots are corroboration only.

value.rationale: Lu Qi-Keng zero-freeness is a basic geometric property of a reproducing kernel. The theorem completely classifies all positive origin powers for the first five natural integer boundary powers, proving m=4 is the first onset, giving the exact critical origin exponent and a nonzero transverse speed. This is a concrete nontrivial boundary for the simplest beta-weight family rather than an arbitrary numeric slice: it explains how origin suppression destroys zero-freeness despite the kernel remaining analytic, and the proof requires global root exclusion by nontrivial degree-five resultant factorization.
